name: cancelAppointment
shortDescription: Cancels an existing patient appointment and updates the doctor's availability.
description:
Overview

Allows a patient or doctor to cancel a scheduled appointment, updating its status and potentially freeing up the doctor's time slot.

Intended use

Called by the patient or doctor UI when an appointment needs to be cancelled. It requires appointmentId.

Logic

  1. Retrieve the Appointment record using params.appointmentId.
  2. Verify that the authenticated user is either the patient associated with the appointment, the doctor, or an admin.
  3. Update the Appointment.status to 'cancelled' using ctx.data.update.
  4. (Optional): Update the Doctor.availabilitySchedule to reflect the newly available slot, if the system manages granular availability.
  5. Send a cancellation confirmation email to both the patient and the doctor using ctx.email.send_template.
  6. Audit-log the appointment cancellation using ctx.audit.log, noting who initiated the cancellation.
  7. Return the updated Appointment record.

Entities

  • Appointment
  • Doctor
  • Patient
